mechanism.claim: Major scheduled BLS releases create real-rate and dollar price discovery. When the first completed ten-minute USDJPY reaction is unusually directional while BTC is already volatile, the macro impulse should propagate into continuously traded BTC over the next twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed USDJPY ten-minute reaction; dollar strength/yen weakness maps BTC long

external_basis.market_attention: Federal Reserve FEDS 2025-022 finds attention amplifies reactions to CPI, Employment Report and Federal Reserve announcements and high-attention announcements tend to overreact
external_basis.global_cycle: NBER 30994 reports positive US payroll and other favorable macro surprises raise global stock prices
external_basis.fx_price_discovery: NBER 8959 documents macro-announcement conditional mean jumps in high-frequency dollar exchange rates
external_basis.calendar: official BLS release schedules; published Eastern times converted with IANA America/New_York

mechanism.why_distinct: HVTMRF uses every Thursday claims window and fades BTC's own one-hour reaction. YLIRTR and HVDFXPR use broad daily FX sessions without official announcement events. HVBLSFX uses only named official BLS releases and the first ten-minute USDJPY reaction; BTC direction is never an input and no prior event or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed pre-release BTC 24-hour variation must occupy its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse DST-aware official macro release clocks and external USDJPY direction are absent from Gross9

release_universe: U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes
features.calendar: official BLS yearly release schedules for 2023-2026; exact published date and time; releases not at 08:30 America/New_York reject
features.fx_reaction: ten exact coherent bars_polygon USDJPY one-minute rows [A,A+10m); log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.reaction_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute FX reaction over at most 120 earlier source-valid selected releases, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT one-minute open-to-close log returns over [A-24h,A)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 120 earlier source-valid selected releases, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.event: both ranks pass; one event per exact timestamp after deduplicating coincident selected releases

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official announcement-conditioned external FX price discovery

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no release universe, timestamp, reaction, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
